name: personal-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins: context status line, inbound-content guardrail, OKF knowledge bundle workflow, communication style, working principles, code quality, git safety, frontend standards.

plugins.name: context-status
plugins.description: Status line showing model, directory, git branch and context window usage.

plugins.name: jev-guard
plugins.description: Inbound-content guardrail: scans web, MCP and network Bash results for prompt injection with TypeSafe Jev.

plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: OKF knowledge bundle workflow: look up docs before work, update after, dedupe, keep index and log in sync. Ships read-only context and context-writer agents; SessionStart hook dispatches them when a bundle exists.

plugins.name: branch-indicator
plugins.description: Shows which git worktree (or branch) the session is working in, at session start and whenever it changes.

plugins.name: communication-style
plugins.description: Injects the ASD-STE100 based Agent Communication & Style Standard, with brevity rules, into every session at start.

plugins.name: working-principles
plugins.description: Injects working principles at session start: fix suggestion protocol, docs as source of truth, surgical changes, planning rules.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Injects code quality rules at session start: no fallbacks, error logging, no upsert, TODO tracking, test safety.

plugins.name: git-safety
plugins.description: Injects git safety rules at session start: no bare git reset --soft in shared repos.

plugins.name: frontend-standards
plugins.description: Injects frontend standards at session start: use the present UI library, semantic HTML, micro-interaction care.
